description: Systems engineering team from Neiva, Colombia, with experience in software architecture, AI and social-impact technology. We are building a web app that harmonizes MODIS (1 km) and VIIRS (375 m) fire data into one burning calendar and map, flagging unusual fire periods. We are looking for members with Earth science or data analysis, GIS or web development, and data visualization skills. Curiosity and willingness to learn matter most.
